name: Takae Mahoro
source:
The protagonist's aunt. She has had relationships, but finds it difficult to accommodate others and believes she isn't suited for marriage.

She has a strong sex drive and tends to become dependent on men. Because of this, she refrains from having relationships with men and satisfies herself through masturbation. 

She decides to make a move on the protagonist, thinking he probably won't make her dependent.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt297/apt297.html#link_character]official site[/url]]
